text_description: A front-facing cropped runway view shows a coordinated black-and-white look built around a boxy, cropped black jacket worn over a longer black underlayer. The jacket has a notched open collar, broad straight shoulders, long sleeves, and a short hem ending around the high waist; three small gold-tone decorative buttons run down the center front, and matching gold buttons accent the wide sleeve cuffs. White contrast panels curve vertically along both side seams of the jacket, creating a graphic cutout-like stripe effect against the black fabric. Beneath it, a black top or tunic extends lower over the hips with a narrow white border at the hem and small gold button details near the upper front pockets or tabs. The lower garment, visible from the waist to upper thigh, is black with large oversized white abstract curved motifs, giving the ensemble a bold graphic monochrome pattern. Styling includes layered statement jewelry: long dangling earrings with red and pale elements and a chunky multicolored necklace at the open neckline. A gold chain-strap bag is partly visible hanging from the model’s left hand. The overall mood is polished and graphic, with structured tailoring, cropped proportions, metallic button accents, and bold black-white contrast.
